newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: Metlife opens Botswana branch office.
newsitem.headline: Metlife opens Botswana branch office.

text.p: South Africa insurer Metropolitan Life announced on Monday that it had opened a Botswana branch office in Gaborone.
Metlife is in partnership with the Botswana Development Corporation (BDC) which holds 25 percent of the equity of Metropolitan Life of Botswana Ltd.

Speaking at the launch of the company, Minister for Commerce and Industry George Kgoroba, representing the Vice-president and Minister for Finance and Development Planning Festus Mogae, welcomed "the breaking of an insurance monopoly" in Botswana.
Botswana Insurance, a partnership between South African group African Life Assurance and Canadian company St Paul, had been the only life assurer in the country.
Metlife has trained and accredited seven Botswana brokers, who will initially operate under the control of Metlife in South Africa.
